saw.title: Grizzly G0887 hydraulic mitre bandsaw
saw.observation: US catalogue USD 24,950 for the bare 20 × 26 inch class three-phase saw. The enquiry adds long-stock support, guarding and commissioning. Verify installed supply and frequency.

weld.title: Everlast Cyclone 503DPi
weld.observation: US catalogue USD 6,199 for the pulsed welder. The maker gives 60% duty at 400 A on its specified 240 V single-phase input. The workcell needs extraction and a verified local power interface.

tracker.title: Metro Metrology equipment rental
tracker.observation: US equipment-only USD 600/day, USD 2,500/week or USD 8,000/month for certified users. Staffed US survey USD 170/hour, ten-hour minimum. Travel, shipping and Baghdad availability require a return.

harness.title: Cirris 4200 tester
harness.observation: Technical example only. The low-voltage unit starts at 128 points and expands to 1,024. Provide independent insulation testing or an appropriately specified higher-voltage variant plus protected adapters.

stress.title: PAUL single-strand stressing equipment
stress.observation: Technical example only. Mobile jack and release equipment use a separately designed bed reaction system. Quote against the strand, force, losses, tails, gauge and release plan.

pump.title: Whitehead Concrete Pumping 2026 rates
pump.observation: US 42 m boom pump USD 225/hour plus USD 4/cubic yard, four-hour minimum, permits and travel extra. A comparator for peak service. The proposed pooled yard-feed allowance assumes local fixed plant with shorter placement reach.

crane.title: C.O.I. Crane Service 2025–2026 rate sheet
crane.observation: US nominal 100 ton class USD 275/hour with an eight-hour minimum plus rigger, fuel and trailers. Capacity at the Airport lift radius is unresolved. The assumed shift rate includes a rigging crew.

freecad.title: FreeCAD project licensing FAQ
freecad.observation: The project permits commercial use of FreeCAD without a licence fee. Workstation setup, postprocessor adaptation, verification and local support still require staff.

fusion.title: Autodesk Fusion subscription types
fusion.observation: US published standard subscription USD 680 per user/year. This optional comparison uses one standard seat. Regional eligibility, post support, future renewals and advanced manufacturing subscriptions require a supplier return.

resources.name: Receiving and long-stock racks
resources.scope: One long-stock cell with rated cantilever racks, axle cradles, tags and quarantine barriers. Building and forklift hire excluded.

resources.name: Guarded section and liner saw
resources.scope: Hydraulic horizontal saw with at least 350 × 320 mm throat and supported long-stock lane. Lower rate assumes equivalent used or locally supplied equipment.

resources.name: Bench preparation and liner drilling
resources.scope: Guarded geared drill, datum stops, replaceable bushes, bench grinder and extraction. Validate spindle runout on a liner.

resources.name: Nested plate blank supply
resources.scope: Reserved CNC laser or plasma cutting and marking for 8–12 mm plate. Price includes supplier setup, machine and operator. Blank plate and freight belong to the parts lot.

resources.name: Indexed 17 m body build bed
resources.scope: Local surveyed 18 × 3.2 m modular body bed with clamps and replaceable locators. Includes the listed fixture components and initial geometry check. Foundation design separate.

resources.name: Removable bogie frame weld bed
resources.scope: Local 3.2 × 2.5 m axle-datum fixture and seat gauges. Includes its removable locators.

resources.name: Mobile pulsed MIG/MAG and source capture
resources.scope: 400 A class pulse GMAW source, feeder, cooler, extraction and local commissioning per set. Major incoming supply and ongoing consumables excluded.

resources.name: Shared runway handling and rigging
resources.scope: Book an existing rated bridge crane plus rigging and operator in grouped shifts. Confirm heaviest lift, spreader weight, usable hook height and roof runway.

resources.name: Shared portable tracker and dimensional QA
resources.scope: Hire calibrated tracker and targets for grouped whole shifts. Local surveyor, travel and lost time between bookings extra. Lower rate assumes a multi-day agreement.

resources.name: Weld inspection and NDT
resources.scope: Contract one field inspection team with calibrated equipment per allocated team-hour. Method, weld coverage, reporting and repeat visits require an approved inspection plan.

resources.name: Contract bogie seat and datum machining
resources.scope: Supplier portal mill or horizontal borer with a surveyed bed that locates both axle planes. Machine, operator and setup only.

resources.name: Contract blast and coating
resources.scope: Subcontract a booth accepting a 17 m body, with preparation, cure and coating team. Coating-system selection, extra blast repair and intershop transport require returns.

resources.name: Bogie integration with clean stands
resources.scope: Axle cradle, positive restraints, rated handling fixtures and calibrated torque tooling per bay.

resources.name: Wheelset and supplier bearing assembly
resources.scope: Press fitting and measurement service for mounted wheelsets. Credit inside purchased wheelset price when included by supplier. Excludes wheelsets and bearings.

resources.name: Restrained bogie functional stand
resources.scope: Guarded functional rig with brake/drive adapters, leak test, recorder and isolation. Full thermal dynamometer and independent type testing excluded.

resources.name: Portal and liner fixture with door support trolley
resources.scope: Opening gauge, liner templates, retention checks and handling trolley. Labour for fitting is in the vehicle routine.

resources.name: Body mechanical and cabin fit
resources.scope: Mobile access platforms and torque/weather-sealing tool packages. Main lifting equipment booked in the crane line.

resources.name: Electrical cabinet and harness build benches
resources.scope: Vehicle build station with crimp/die and pull testing, ESD and isolated supply. Production boards and cables are in the fleet lot.

resources.name: Shared cabinet and harness tester
resources.scope: Expandable continuity system, independent insulation test and keyed adapters. Return pin count, protected paths, measurement ranges and calibration.

resources.name: Onboard collector set install tools
resources.scope: Portable insulated setup fixture, spring/contact gauge and calibrated indicating tools for an installed collector.

resources.name: Body lift and marriage road
resources.scope: One synchronized rail-vehicle lifting set with mechanical locks, cradles and logging. Number and rating of columns require installed mass, lift points and unbalanced load case.

resources.name: Static integration and factory acceptance test road
resources.scope: Portable car wheel-load measuring system, brake and electrical instruments with isolated test area. Floor, track construction and route tests excluded.

resources.name: Set-level integration and controls test road
resources.scope: Grouped shifts booking an existing full-length protected and isolated six-car test road. Construction of a new road requires a separate site estimate.

resources.name: Off-line exchange and repair road
resources.scope: Second lift and support set, exchange pallet, isolation and repair bench for the depot. Civil repair-road construction belongs to the depot lot.

resources.name: Wet-cast box mould and prestress position
resources.scope: Per 10 m box mould including retractable core, end plates and allocated reaction-bed fabrication. Shared stressing jack separately priced. Ground improvement and building excluded.

resources.name: Beam reinforcement cage build and check jig
resources.scope: One cage assembly position including gauges, jig and allocated share of a common cut-and-bend service setup. Reinforcement stock and production labour excluded.

resources.name: Calibrated stressing and controlled detensioning plant
resources.scope: Buy a shared calibrated jack, pump, detensioning, grips and protection. Fixed reactions belong to the mould positions. Actual force and anchor design require specialist review.

resources.name: Shared batching and concrete delivery to placement crews
resources.scope: Shared metered concrete delivery and placing equipment with operator, assumed 20 m³/h gross. Mix material and finishing crew excluded. Beam hours known, panel workload outstanding.

resources.name: Beam placement, vibration and finishing crews
resources.scope: Crew-hour for placement, vibration and finishing. Concrete and paid pump operator excluded. Provide shifted coverage during staggered releases.

resources.name: Beam yard lifting and trailer loadout
resources.scope: Operated precast-yard crane and rigging for stripping and loading. Verify cast gross load at working radius and actual ground capacity.

resources.name: Single-tier beam storage and dispatch buffer
resources.scope: One set of reusable dunnage, lateral restraint, marking and layout per single-tier slot. Yard lease and permanent paving remain in the yard lot.

resources.name: Beam tractor, matched trailer and haul crew
resources.scope: One loaded beam per local low-loader trip with return leg, driver and routine restraint. Abnormal permits, exceptional haul distance and escorts require route-specific pricing.

resources.name: Foundation, column and cap work areas
resources.scope: Survey setout, staging and record at each support position only. Excavation, piles, ground treatment, rig mobilisation and permanent piers require ground and design returns.

resources.name: Bearing seat survey and installation crews
resources.scope: Installation team with calibrated survey and torque tools per bearing. Bearing supply, plate, anchor, grout materials and future replacement excluded.

resources.name: Site erection front and at-radius crane service
resources.scope: One site crane and crew in booked erection shifts at the assumed eight lifts/day. Include standard rigging. Obtain crane chart, access and ground works, mobilisation and traffic pricing separately.

resources.name: Flat station panel casting table
resources.scope: One adaptable panel table with shutters and edge/insert gauges. Price four provisional positions pending the station-bay count and duty.

resources.name: Panel strip, yard and dispatch handling
resources.scope: Operated panel handling crane per shift with rig. Panel quantity and booked shifts open. If the same crane serves beam lifting, combine bookings and credit the overlap.

resources.name: Adjustable enclosure and removable backplate assembly stand
resources.scope: Backplate assembly stand with adjustable stops, template and controlled fastening equipment. Include integrator-owned equipment as supplier credit.

resources.name: Wire preparation, labelled kitting and crimp inspection station
resources.scope: Bench cutter/stripper, matched crimp dies, ferrule labelling and pull tester for LV wire. High-power busbars and cable installation belong to power lots.

resources.name: Isolated low-voltage I/O proving bench with removable test harness
resources.scope: Programmable isolated supply, protection and signalling interface simulator, breakout, recorder and controlled adapters. Excludes live HV fault tests.

resources.name: Supplier switchgear and rectifier test provision
resources.scope: Factory routine acceptance service and witness per installed rectifier cabinet. Cabinet count, special type tests, HV laboratory and travel require supplier returns.

open_quantity_sensitivities.label: 6 nominal island templates, 600 panels
open_quantity_sensitivities.driver: station bay panels after plant and access openings

lines.scope: One CAD/CAM workstation, dual screens, UPS and local backup for the manufacturing technician.
lines.scope_credit: Existing engineering PC or CAM supplier's workstation.

lines.scope: One rugged shop-floor reader for released drawings, work instructions and offline exercises.
lines.scope_credit: Existing workstation or ERP terminal in the parent shop.

lines.scope: FreeCAD desktop licence on the technician's PC. Reader uses a browser and the offline material.
lines.scope_credit: No commercial seat fee for the chosen open-source tool.

lines.scope: One systems technician for one eight-hour day to install pinned software, test imports and record restore steps.
lines.scope_credit: Buyer IT setup, including any installation bundled in the workstation quote.

lines.scope: One CAM specialist for three eight-hour days to configure one machine/controller post and document its constraints.
lines.scope_credit: Contract cutter's own postprocessor and setup fee.

lines.scope: One reviewer for one eight-hour day for source geometry versus post output, offline backplot and independent review record.
lines.scope_credit: Existing CAM validation or engineering-assurance labour.

lines.scope: Two supervised four-hour sessions for one cohort covering the seven workshop roles, followed by a skills handover.
lines.scope_credit: Supplier training included with the machine or buyer induction.

lines.scope: Seven learners participate in both four-hour sessions. Attendance is owner time at a loaded hourly rate.
lines.scope_credit: Existing workforce payroll. Use as an opportunity cost when payroll is funded.

lines.scope: One owner quality representative for two eight-hour first-off visits, separate from the inspection supplier.
Two supervised shop bookings for sample preparation and first-off cuts against four plate families plus a representative saw cut. Includes shop time and sample stock.
lines.scope_credit: Cutting supplier's setup, coupons or first article in the fleet contract.

lines.scope: Two staffed first-off inspection visits for datum and dimensional checks with calibrated instruments and reports. Confirm instrument uncertainty against each feature.
lines.scope_credit: Credit the instrument hire and inspection labour where the series metrology booking already contains this work.

lines.scope: Two eight-hour days per year for backup restore, postprocessor change review and a reference backplot.
lines.scope_credit: Included support, software assurance and workstation IT contracts.

lines.scope: Optional substitution of one standard commercial seat for the FreeCAD seat. Revalidate the post and confirm Iraqi licence terms before purchase.
lines.scope_credit: Alternative subscription. Exclude when budgeting the open-source scenario.
